title: What One Sample Cannot See: Why Fewer Denoising Steps Can Score Higher on Physics Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2611.25632v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a storm can head north or south, a forecast down the middle may score better under squared error than either plausible path. The same paradox appears when video generators are tested as world models: fewer denoising steps can raise physics scores even as videos blur or stop moving early. Why? Physics-IQ compares each generated video with one recording, although a scene can have multiple valid futures. An exact decomposition shows its scores can reward reduced variation among generated futures, even when their distribution becomes less accurate. We introduce Kernel Physics-IQ to remove this incentive in expectation, needing only two independent samples per condition. Two-step sampling lowers Kernel Physics-IQ in all five image-to-video models. For CogVideoX, the official score rises by 0.055 while ours falls by 0.131. translated_title: 单一样本无法看到什么：为什么更少的去噪步骤能在物理基准上获得更高分数
translated_abstract: 当一场风暴可能向北或向南移动时，预测中间路径在平方误差下可能比任何一条合理路径的得分都高。当视频生成器被作为世界模型进行测试时，同样的悖论出现了：即使视频变得模糊或提前停止运动，更少的去噪步骤反而能提高物理分数。为什么？因为Physics-IQ将每个生成的视频与一段真实录像进行比较，而一个场景实际上可以有多种有效的未来。精确的分解表明，该基准的分数可能奖励生成未来之间变异性的减少，即使其分布变得不那么准确。我们提出Kernel Physics-IQ以在期望意义上消除这种激励，每个条件只需要两个独立样本。在所有五个图像到视频模型中，两步采样都降低了Kernel Physics-IQ分数。以CogVideoX为例，官方分数上升了0.055，而我们的分数却下降了0.131。改变采样调度还揭示了官方分数未能捕捉到的更多差异。
tldr: 现有Physics-IQ基准通过将生成视频与单一参考录像比较，会奖励牺牲多样性、趋于“折中”的模糊预测，即使这些预测的分布更不准确；本文提出仅需两个样本的Kernel Physics-IQ基准来消除这一偏差，并证明更少的去噪步骤虽然提高了官方分数，却降低了真实的物理保真度。
en_tdlr: The Physics-IQ benchmark rewards "hedged" predictions that reduce variation among generated futures even when their distribution becomes less accurate; the authors propose Kernel Physics-IQ, requiring only two samples per condition, to remove this bias and show that fewer denoising steps raise official scores while actually degrading physical fidelity.
